svg.title: Precog SOC architecture as an isometric stack of seven layers
svg.desc: From bottom to top: replay inputs, NIDS core, security events with ATT&CK, live attack graph, Precog Engine, world state and API, and the clients. Data flows up; the containment action flows back down to the replay.
svg.text: Data flows up. Contain flows back down, the replay resumes and Precog re-evaluates.
Contain: propose, confirm, state changes, replay resumes
Installable PWA plus a desktop 3D console.
Both poll about every 1.5 s and show the same state.
One version counter and 25 add-on routes under /api/x.
Clients ask: anything new since version N?
Markov next-host model: Top-3 targets with confidence.
Each forecast is later scored as a hit or a miss.
networkx graph of hosts and observed connections,
plus attackgraph for topology and feasible paths.
SQLite packet table and Isolation Forest detector.
and attempted moves, played back on a timer.
